railTitle.description: The rail prefix the skill's loop authored, e.g. "[harness-loop]".

spineShape.description: The spine node ids in order (excursions excluded), e.g. [boot, backpressure, observe, drain-gate, retro-drain, retro-harvest, improve].

navUsed.description: The position verb the skill prescribed and you ran, e.g. "nav set". A migrated skill uses nav, not a legacy cursor verb.

hookCommandsPresent.description: The --hook tokens seen on node command fields, e.g. [pre-flight, pre-coding, post-coding, post-flight].

validates.description: Did `harness flow render` exit 0 on the authored flow?

flowPath.description: Absolute or repo-relative path to the throwaway loop.flow.json under $OUT (the scorer reads this).

cursorCalled.description: Did any prescribed command use a legacy `flow cursor` verb instead of `nav`? (Expected false.)

summary.description: One-paragraph faithful account of what the skill authored and how it was driven.
